findings.description: Direct sit and crouch images show the front lap panels still lift and separate from the thighs: fitted shorts and large areas of upper thigh remain exposed while angular side/rear skirt panels hang behind the bent legs. The center-lap revision has not achieved coherent lap coverage.
Front, three-quarter and side views show uneven, crumpled planar creases and gathered ridges across the overskirt rather than controlled pleats; the side/rear fold mass remains visibly lumpy.

The direct back view has no clearly legible attached adjustment tab or buckle. A small side protrusion is visible at the waist in oblique views but its tab/buckle form is not identifiable from the rear.
The jacket reads mostly as plain ivory; seam piping and elbow quilting are very low contrast and do not clearly convey the intended fencing-set construction in the five views.
No authored UV layout is present for this prototype. UV status remains NOT_CREATED; the rendered preview does not establish UV mapping.

sourceEvidence.currentPrototypeMotif: V21 separated front center-lap panels and flank panels with sewn joins, using a 3D build, cloth trial, skin/export, five-view and six-pose render. Direct review of this current revision still finds exposed front thighs in sit/crouch, irregular side/rear folds, an illegible rear tab, faint jacket details, and no authored UV layout.

nextAction: REJECT. Keep as unapproved prototype. Change skirt panel and cloth construction to retain front lap coverage through sit and crouch while controlling side/rear drape; preserve opaque shorts. Reduce irregular faceting, make the rear tab/buckle clearly identifiable from the back, and strengthen jacket seam and elbow details. Author UVs from the current mesh before UV acceptance. Then build a new revision and directly inspect all five views and six poses. Fit, Shape Keys, Unity/VRChat runtime, package, and release remain unverified or blocked.
